gold_sources.condition_instances: each day/week has a distinct published instance; daily progress reset does not renew receipts

wheel.four_orange_policy: 只按第4周排期，不检测真实装备培养状态

player_experience.status: 已由服务端copyExperience73.csv绝对经验表加载；方案旧文字未单独发玩家经验。全队毕业模拟另行复核。

projection_status: V13已重算货币机会成本和在售数量；跨全部来源的90—180天模拟仍须按本轮副本、活动、抽卡、排名实际数据合并，禁止宣称已验证毕业天数。

deployment_overrides.runtime_authority: existing admin tables populated by the explicit apply-growth74 command

score.additional: real applied damage / original per-wanted score divisor; original performance and damage ranking rewards separate

point.formula: sum floor1..N ((50+10*floor)*3) + floor(N/3)*900; only actually accepted wins and section claims

credit.actual_source: settled chip exchange, mean19.5 per chip; desert runtime not yet connected means this is conditional, not live guaranteed income

economy75.rare_pricing_note: Rare currency prices include source scarcity/weekly quota premium; reference diamond values are budget units, no new direct sales

red_fragment_projection.with_credit_or_recharge: can shorten; no unconditional guaranteed day90 graduation

economy75.risk: Conditional stages, PVP/Wanted actual income, paid selectors, forge donors and reset returns require integrated simulator after all source changes; this file does not claim a full 180-day economy has passed gameplay validation
